positions.name: MeridianReplacesZypherionOnStreaming
positions.frame: What database is the analytics pipeline moving to now, on what capability grounds, and on what timeline, after the earlier choice was reconsidered?
positions.why: All five segments read the same revised analytics database decision. src-1 gives the CTO's switch and its evaluation basis, src-3 records the replacement, src-4 gives the streaming-ingestion reason, and src-5 keeps the Q3 2026 window. src-2 is the submitter's performed supersession of the earlier Zypherion decision, so it belongs with the group it overrides. The group sets a streaming-capability ground against the earlier 15x columnar-performance ground. The frame shifts from performance grounds to a capability reason, so this is a new position that supersedes the old one rather than a revision of its membership.
